name: Clued production publisher Host qualification

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/clued-production-publisher-*-qualification.yml'
      - 'scripts/ci/self-hosted/publisher-qualification-case.json'
      - 'scripts/ci/self-hosted/run-publisher-qualification-case*'
      - 'scripts/ci/self-hosted/qualify-publisher-host-principal*'
      - 'scripts/ci/self-hosted/production-publisher-profile.json'
      - 'scripts/runner/clued-production-vm*'
      - 'scripts/runner/clued-runner-job-started*'
      - 'scripts/ci/clued-gated-proof-*'
      - '.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage/**'
      - 'docs/maintenance/ci-publisher-principal-isolation.md'
      - 'docs/maintenance/production-publisher-vm.md'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: clued-publisher-host-qualification-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# purpose: production_publisher_nonproduction_PR_qualification
# classification: qualification_only
# This job cannot grant production authority. Failure and cancellation cases
# remain qualification observations, outside requiredSuccess.
jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  host-principal-probe:
    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'pull_request') &&
      (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main') &&
      (github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name == github.repository) &&
      (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) &&
      (github.event.pull_request.user.login == github.repository_owner) &&
      (github.actor == github.repository_owner) &&
      (github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner))
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Windows, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal, cap-python312, cap-node24, site-company]
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Observe the actual Windows CI principal with the fixed public case
        run: node scripts/ci/self-hosted/run-publisher-qualification-case.mjs --kind host

host-principal-probe.if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && ((github.event_name == 'pull_request') && (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main') && (github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name == github.repository) && (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) && (github.event.pull_request.user.login == github.repository_owner) && (github.actor == github.repository_owner) && (github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner))

steps.name: Observe the actual Windows CI principal with the fixed public case

name: Clued production publisher Guest qualification

on:
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
    paths:
      - '.github/workflows/clued-production-publisher-*-qualification.yml'
      - 'scripts/ci/self-hosted/publisher-qualification-case.json'
      - 'scripts/ci/self-hosted/run-publisher-qualification-case*'
      - 'scripts/ci/self-hosted/qualify-publisher-host-principal*'

      - 'scripts/ci/clued-gated-proof-*'
      - '.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage/**'
      - 'docs/maintenance/ci-publisher-principal-isolation.md'
      - 'docs/maintenance/production-publisher-vm.md'

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: clued-publisher-guest-qualification-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

# purpose: production_publisher_nonproduction_PR_qualification
# classification: qualification_only
# This job cannot grant production authority. Failure and cancellation cases
# remain qualification observations, outside requiredSuccess.
jobs:
  admission-gate:
    name: admission-gate
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued, pool-general, trust-internal]
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      actions: read
      checks: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      admitted: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.admitted }}
      enforced: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.enforced }}
      verdict: ${{ steps.gate.outputs.verdict }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha || github.event.repository.default_branch }}
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - id: gate
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node scripts/ci/clued-work-admission.mjs --mode gate

  qualify:
    needs: admission-gate
    if: >-
      needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'pull_request') &&
      (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main') &&
      (github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name == github.repository) &&
      (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) &&
      (github.event.pull_request.user.login == github.repository_owner) &&
      (github.actor == github.repository_owner) &&
      (github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner))
    runs-on: [self-hosted, Linux, X64, clued-production-publisher-v1, "${{ format('clued-publisher-{0}-{1}', github.run_id, github.run_attempt) }}"]
    timeout-minutes: 12
    steps:
      # HARD EXTERNAL PREREQUISITE: an immutable installed pre-job hook and
      # trusted Host controller must bind this exact run/attempt/job/merge/head/
      # base/runner/case before ANY step. The observer below cannot supply it.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
      - name: Configure job temporary storage
        uses: ./.github/actions/ci-temporary-storage
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: 24.19.0
      - name: Observe the fixed credential-free Guest case
        run: node scripts/ci/self-hosted/run-publisher-qualification-case.mjs --kind guest

qualify.if: needs.admission-gate.outputs.admitted == 'true' && ((github.event_name == 'pull_request') && (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main') && (github.event.pull_request.base.repo.full_name == github.repository) && (github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository) && (github.event.pull_request.user.login == github.repository_owner) && (github.actor == github.repository_owner) && (github.triggering_actor == github.repository_owner))

steps.name: Observe the fixed credential-free Guest case
